message: Fern silently drops enum value "one" from the generated SDK: its name "one" matches the name "One" of the earlier value "1" when compared case-insensitively. Give each value a unique name with x-fern-enum.

Fern silently drops enum value "inProgress" from the generated SDK: its name "inProgress" matches the name "InProgress" of the earlier value "in-progress" when compared case-insensitively. Give each value a unique name with x-fern-enum.
